title: Mother and sister delivering market for a butcher
summary: Her mother and sister delivered market orders paid in meat.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Because my sister, she was small too. And my mother had them working for a man to market. He used to have to carry the people's market and the great big best. He'd put the names on them, the address. And they didn't have all these delivery trucks like they got. Now that was magazine market. A big market magazine in St. Mary's. Well, they used to go and get that market and soon the morning and deliver it around for him. He'd pay them what he wants and they'd give them lights and deliver them. The people didn't buy them things. They had lights. They'd give you that to make a big pot. Give them the peas feed and the hog hedge. My mom used to make hog hedge keys out of that. He'd just give it to us because they'd wait for him. You know, can't stuff around. And he didn't pay them a salary. Like, you know, he'd give them a dollar or two dollars. But he'd give them plenty of meat. And other butchers would say, well, you go in the same address. This is something. Give them a so-and-so. Well, they'd give them chop or so. They always had plenty of fresh meat.
